item.title: 0.9.4c
item.description:
## Vireo 0.9.4c
Vireo 0.9.4c fixes wrong replies from Inkling 2 Mini and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on M1–M4 Macs, and shows who a message will go to before you approve it.
### Right answers on M1–M4 Macs
- **Inkling 2 Mini and Gemma 4 26B-A4B could go wrong after a long read.** On Macs without the M5's GPU accelerators, the engine sometimes reused part of an earlier, longer batch of text when reading the next one. Replies could drift off topic or get facts wrong, and the same question could get a different answer each time. The model's scores were off by as much as 6.6 before the fix; they now match the reference to within 0.04 and are the same on every run. - M5 Macs weren't affected in normal use.
### Approving a message
- When Vireo asks to send a text in Messages, the "To" line now shows the contact it found and the phone number or email it will send to, not only the name the model typed.
### Inkling 2 Mini as an agent
- Counts both the first and last day of a date range, such as the days of a trip for a per diem. - When a request is outside what a policy allows, says so and writes nothing down, instead of recording an approval.
In our test run of seven agent tasks, Inkling 2 Mini passed 5 and half-passed 2, up from 4 passed, 2 half-passed and 1 failed.
Everything else in [0.9.4b](https://github.com/InvurseStudio/Vireo-app/releases/tag/v0.9.4b) is unchanged.
### Requirements
A Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or later) and macOS 14 or later. Inkling 2 Mini needs 48 GB of memory or more; its smaller and native 4-bit versions, 32 GB.
